trigger_condition: Two or more items array entries contain identical text
guard_snippet: key={`${index}-${item}`} (use index as part of key)
potential_consequence: React key collision; duplicate item silently dropped or state misassigned

trigger_condition: items array contains only whitespace-only strings e.g. ['   ']
potential_consequence: Heading and empty styled pill rendered; user sees blank bubble

trigger_condition: Component restructure moves h5 outside a div ancestor
guard_snippet: const container = screen.getByRole('list').closest('[class*=flex]') or query by heading role
potential_consequence: closest('div') returns null; non-null assertion throws TypeError, hiding real failure
